id: typescript-gateway-controlui-insecure-auth-bypass-device-auth
title: Control UI allowInsecureAuth flag bypasses secure-context and device-auth checks
summary: 'The WebSocket connect handler built its Control UI bypass flag from the `allowInsecureAuth`
  config toggle. With it set, a Control UI client could skip device identity and the HTTPS/localhost secure-context
  requirement and authenticate with only a shared token over plain HTTP. That exposes the token to interception
  and removes device binding of scopes. The security audit text also described this behavior as intended.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-287
- CWE-319
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- typescript
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 40a292619e1f2be3a3b1db663d7494c9c2dc0abf
  vulnerable_ref: 40a292619e1f2be3a3b1db663d7494c9c2dc0abf^
  patched_ref: 40a292619e1f2be3a3b1db663d7494c9c2dc0abf
  repository: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
rule:
  message: 'The Control UI bypass decision includes an "allow insecure auth" setting, so token-only auth
    can skip

    device identity and the secure-context requirement over HTTP. Only the explicit

    dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth setting should relax these checks.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - patterns:
    - pattern-either:
      - pattern: 'const $BYPASS = $INSECURE || $DISABLE;

          '
      - pattern: 'const $BYPASS = $DISABLE || $INSECURE;

          '
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $INSECURE
        regex: (?i).*(allowInsecure|insecureControlUi|insecureAuth).*
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $BYPASS
        regex: (?i).*bypass.*
  - pattern-regex: allowInsecureAuth=true allows token-only auth over HTTP
fix:
  guidance: 'Do not let the legacy allowInsecureAuth toggle influence the Control UI bypass decision.
    Derive the bypass flag only from the explicit dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth setting, and keep requiring
    a device identity and secure context for the Control UI otherwise. Keep allowInsecureAuth only as
    a legacy value for audit and logging, and word audit messages to say it no longer bypasses device
    auth.

    '
  example: "const allowInsecureControlUi =\n  isControlUi && configSnapshot.gateway?.controlUi?.allowInsecureAuth\
    \ === true;\nconst disableControlUiDeviceAuth =\n  isControlUi && configSnapshot.gateway?.controlUi?.dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth\
    \ === true;\n// allowInsecureAuth is retained for compatibility but must not bypass device auth\n\
    const allowControlUiBypass = disableControlUiDeviceAuth;\n"
